2608.01720.title: When Extreme Darkness Meets Motion Blur: MeanFlow for Unified RAW Restoration
2608.01720.paper_summary: Extremely low-light RAW enhancement aims to recover severely attenuated sensor signals, yet existing methods often focus on illumination and noise while overlooking the motion-induced degradations inherent in practical low-light imaging. We present a framework for robust extremely low-light RAW enhancement under realistic acquisition degradations. First, we introduce See in the Degraded Extremely Dark (SIDED), a new dataset that applies controlled motion degradation to extremely low-light RAW pairs while retaining their original sensor noise. Second, we propose a unified RAW tokenizer equipped with explicit domain-conditioned representation calibration to align extremely low-light and well-exposed RAW data, followed by a MeanFlow that performs enhancement in a single function evaluation. To our knowledge, this is the first work to formulate extremely low-light RAW enhancement under realistic motion-degraded acquisition and address it with MeanFlow. We further introduce a physics-guided refinement model to strengthen illumination--reflectance consistency, pixel fidelity, and color preservation without incurring additional inference cost. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our framework achieves state-of-the-art performance in extremely low-light RAW enhancement, and robustly handles coupled motion and noise degradations.
2608.01720.paper_summary_zh: 極低光環境下的RAW增強旨在恢復嚴重衰減的感測器信號，然而現有的方法往往專注於照明和噪聲，卻忽略了實際低光成像中固有的運動引起的退化。我們提出了一個在現實獲取退化下進行穩健極低光RAW增強的框架。首先，我們介紹了「在退化的極暗環境中觀察」（SIDED），這是一個新的數據集，對極低光RAW對進行了控制的運動退化，同時保留其原始的感測器噪聲。其次，我們提出了一個統一的RAW標記器，配備明確的領域條件表示校準，以對齊極低光和良好曝光的RAW數據，隨後由MeanFlow執行單一函數評估中的增強。據我們所知，這是首個在現實運動退化獲取下制定極低光RAW增強的工作，並用MeanFlow進行處理。我們進一步引入了一個物理引導的精煉模型，以加強照明-反射一致性、像素真實性和顏色保留，而不產生額外的推理成本。大量實驗表明，我們的框架在極低光RAW增強方面達到了最先進的性能，並穩健地處理了耦合的運動和噪聲退化。
